#> 🌍 Reasons against prioritizing Wild Animals

  !!!(💡|gray_background) Most texts in this resource page talk about the importance of wild animal suffering as a cause area. This section deals with texts that explicitly argue that we should in fact not try to reduce said suffering, on a variety of grounds.
